critical_notes: FRAMEWORK MISMATCH: The test case describes a generic user registration flow, but the AURA framework is purpose-built for HP Instant Ink enrollment with HPID authentication.
The file resolution report confirmed that NO components exist in AURA for this registration flow - only infrastructure files (BasePageObject, PlaywrightManager, test_flows_common).
All 3 page objects (HomePage, RegistrationPage, RegistrationSuccessPage) were created from scratch with 11 total locators and 13 total methods.
The test uses common.generate_tenant_email() to generate unique test data (username and email) to avoid conflicts.
All locators use data-testid selectors following AURA framework conventions. If the application does not have data-testid attributes, the locators must be updated.
The mapping report (final_graphify_report.json) was NOT AVAILABLE in the repository, so the test was generated based solely on the test case analysis and file resolution report.
Estimated development effort to implement the actual application pages: 3-5 days for a developer familiar with the application.
